Prioritize downside risk testing for this project context.

Investor lens overrides:
- Treat evidence claims as weak unless each metric includes baseline, current value, and timeframe.
- Penalize market scoring when TAM is presented without bottom-up expansion assumptions.
- Penalize structure if risk disclosure and failure mode are absent.
- Elevate critique quality on go-to-market realism and concentration risk in early customers.
- Reward explicit milestone-linked capital plan more than narrative polish.
- Keep grading strict: reserve scores above 75 only for unusually de-risked execution proof.
